commentary.text: 90+8' Mateo Busquets Ferrer is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
90+8' Sevilla will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field.
90+7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets Ferrer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+6' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+6' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90+5' The game is interrupted now, Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+3' Quique Sanchez Flores has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla) replacing Oliver Torres.

90+2' 3 - 2 Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) displays what a brilliant free kick master he is, especially from this distance. He hits the ball very well and scores with a low shot inside the left post, leaving the keeper helpless.
90+2' Handball! A player from Sevilla handled the ball. Real Sociedad are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
90+1' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
87' Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
86' Loic Bade (Sevilla) is being substituted because of an injury. Quique Sanchez Flores sends Tanguy Nianzou on the pitch.
86' Substitution. Isaac Romero walks off the pitch and Alejo Veliz (Sevilla) comes on as a substitute.
85' Loic Bade (Sevilla) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
84' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Jon Ander Olasagasti and he is replaced by Jon Magunazelaia Argoitia (Real Sociedad).
84' It is time for a substitution. Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) is on for Kieran Tierney.
84' Real Sociedad win a corner.
80' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.
79' The current number of shots on goal is 5:2.
76' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul.
73' Here is a change. Martin Zubimendi is going off and Imanol Alguacil gives the last tactical orders to Urko Gonzalez (Real Sociedad).
73' That will be all from Andre Silva who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad).
70' Real Sociedad seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
67' Mateo Busquets Ferrer shows a yellow card to Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) for his blatant foul.
65' 3 - 1 Goooooal! Oliver Torres beats his man and slings in a cross towards Sergio Ramos (Sevilla), who evades his marker and plants a fine header into the bottom left corner from close in. 3:1.
65' Suso (Sevilla) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
61' The referee signals a substitution. Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Arsen Zakharyan.
58' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul after Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
57' Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) is able to continue to play.
55' Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
54' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Isaac Romero (Sevilla) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
53' Substitution. Hannibal Mejbri makes his way off the pitch and Suso (Sevilla) comes on as his replacement.
52' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) commits a rough foul. Mateo Busquets Ferrer stops the game and makes a call.
50' The referee blows his whistle as Hannibal Mejbri (Sevilla) was too aggressive in his challenge.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Quique Sanchez Flores gives a chance to Juanlu Sanchez and Jesus Navas (Sevilla) is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' 2 - 1 Goal! Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Orjan Nyland into the bottom right corner.
45+5' Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+4' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) touches the ball with his hand inside the box! PENALTY to Real Sociedad! Let's see who will take responsibility.
45+1' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) picks up an injury.
42' Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
41' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
41' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
40' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mateo Busquets Ferrer no option but to blow his whistle.
38' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
36' Flag goes up against Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
35' Mateo Busquets Ferrer couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Kike Salas (Sevilla) and blew his whistle.
31' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Loic Bade (Sevilla) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer signals.
25' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
25' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Real Sociedad.
23' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul.
22' The ball possession is 36:64.
18' A lofted cross from Jesus Navas (Sevilla) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
16' Some great controlled play and passing from Real Sociedad. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
13' 2 - 0 Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect strike into the roof of the net and behind the goalkeeper.
11' 1 - 0 Goal! Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:0.
11' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Alex Remiro pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
11' Sevilla quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
10' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
9' The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.

9' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Orjan Nyland easily deals with the threat. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
7' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
6' Real Sociedad control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
4' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Alex Remiro.
3' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) watches the cross all the way and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort flashes narrowly wide of the left post.
2' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Real Sociedad was in an offside position.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Real Sociedad will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Mateo Busquets Ferrer.
